sloka: अद्य बार्हस्पतः श्रीमान् युक्तः पुष्यो न राघव ।प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वम् असि दुर्मनाः ॥२-२६-९॥
transliteration: adya bārhaspataḥ śrīmān yuktaḥ puṣyo na rāghava ।procyate brāhmaṇaiḥ prājñaiḥ kena tvam asi durmanāḥ ॥2-26-9॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghu race, today has been declared by learned brahmins a suitable and auspicious day for consecration under Pushya star with Brihaspati as presiding deity. Then why are you dejected?
